proposed_versioned_additions.question: When resolving Liquidation, may a district already in strike or outage be selected? Does its non-exploitation or orgcrime exception waive that printed target restriction?
proposed_versioned_additions.expected_answer: No. Liquidation instructs the resolver to choose one district not in strike or outage. Producing without exploiting and ignoring orgcrime do not waive that target restriction.
asked_facts: A district already in strike cannot be selected.
A district already in outage cannot be selected.
Neither the non-exploitation clarification nor the orgcrime override removes the printed target condition.
